cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a desert oasis at golden hour — holds a water bottle at chest height; a harbour quay of a port town with tall sailing ships — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a Three Kingdoms festival street — lying on her side; a Roman marble bath hall — standing; a festival street of lanterns — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a small shop — trims the stems of a few loose flower stems on the worktable; a narrow city alley with hanging signboards and wet pavement — sitting on the ground; a space-station docking bay with a sleek shuttle on its pad and long light strips — standing; a Guan Yu temple — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — chest-deep in the water; a Peking opera dressing room — holds her keepsake at chest height; a small shop — standing; a circus tent ring under a striped canopy — sitting on the ground
